speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) how often do NEA and SFA conduct checks on the hygiene of food stalls and catering licensees; (b) whether these have been affected by the circuit breaker measures; and (c) what steps are taken to work with food stall licensees to improve cleanliness and hygiene standards when such stalls are faced with licence suspensions.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: These include maintaining and cleaning their stalls regularly, ensuring that workers who handle food have attended and passed the requisite food safety courses, and having proper infrastructure in place to safely prepare, handle and sell food.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: SFA conducts routine inspections to ensure that the food safety regulations are adhered to.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The inspection frequency is guided by the risk profile of the food establishments, which is based on the premises type, nature of food sold, food handling process and compliance track record.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: SFA also conducts ad hoc inspections in response to feedback received from the public.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In February, when we started detecting COVID-19 cases in Singapore, my Ministry launched the SG Clean campaign to rally all Singaporeans to keep Singapore clean.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As part of the campaign, we introduced sanitation and hygiene checklists for food establishments which highlighted key practices to safeguard food safety and reduce contamination risks.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: SFA and NEA also issued joint advisories and stepped up engagement efforts with food establishments on the importance of ramping up cleaning efforts to safeguard public health.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Such engagement efforts and food safety checks continued during the circuit breaker period, when critical food services were allowed to remain open for takeaway and delivery services, to ensure food safety for consumers.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: SFA also ensures that food establishments that have breached any of the licensing conditions are aware of the rectifications needed to comply with them.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: SFA will inform licensees of the necessary corrective actions whenever a food safety lapse is detected during an inspection.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The BFHC equips food handlers with relevant food safety and hygiene knowledge, including proper food handling and good personal hygiene practices.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: SFA will also carry out a re-inspection after the suspension has been lifted to ensure the food establishment has rectified the lapses.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Since the circuit breaker, we have seen an increase in the use of food delivery services, I have two supplementary questions.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Will the Ministry consider looking into guidelines to mandate F&B merchants on food delivery platforms to display the relevant grades or awards obtained under the Food Hygiene Recognition Scheme (FHRS) so that customers are aware and have access to the information?

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: And secondly, whether food delivery riders are regulated or fall under the FHRS and if so, how?

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: She has given us some food for thought.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: At the same time, the delivery personnel are not licensed under our food safety framework as well.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: Similarly, we will consider her suggestions when we next review the framework.
